column1: # christianv1673 key: Danish royal chancery code of 1673-74 (Christian V to the envoys Jens Juel and Christoffer Lindenov), CC BY 4.0
# (Brice Dudout, Europe chiffree, 2026). Rebuilt from the interlinear decipherments of the time of the orders of 21 July and 3 Oct 1674
# (same unit, images 32-41) and from the chancery's decipherment leaf of the first block of 25 May 1673 (image 9 right).
# System: three-digit code groups in alphabetical blocks: five syllables per initial (417-421 ba be bi bo bu, 447-451 ca ... cu,
# 876-879), each followed by words of that initial (585 haffuer, 589 holde, 595 hvor ...); names and countries in 2xx-3xx
# (284 Sverig, 309 Holland, 321 Franckrig); small numbers and signs for single letters; Danish words often left in clear.
# The hand of 1673 gives some signs other values than the 1674 hands (barred m = k in 1673, u in 1674; 3 = u in 1673).
# section A: KEY-v2 exactly as frozen and measured (frozen/working/KEY-v2.json, SHA-256 5334c7aa...; 222 entries, the 4 "RAW" notation
#   entries of that file are left out here). Value = weighted majority of the glosses. Validated on the held-out order of 6 Oct 1674.
# section B: values of the 1673 hand for small numbers and signs (from the decipherment leaf), used to decode the closing block.
#   29 = x was added to section B at the integration check of 12 Nov 2026 (it gives 'exempel' in line T10 of the closing block).
# section C: added AFTER the measurement, not measured: 486 du and 534 fu (from the syllable blocks), 590 huis (gloss 'huis' in the
#   1674 order C, image 43, and the h block 580-596; KEY-v2 has 'sind' from one gloss of image 41).
# Groups of the closing block with no value anywhere in the volume: 32, 320, 348, 384, 646, 906.
